intent: 荒野上的龙卷风：漏斗状的烟尘柱旋转，带 3D 透视感
pass_criteria: vertical funnel/column of particles, wider top narrower base (or readable taper)
dense enough to read as a coherent volume, not a coil/spring
3D perspective feel (camera looking at the funnel, not flat 2D)

params: Emitter Type (Box: enables Emitter Size so each spawn fills a vertical segment)
Emitter Size X (thin: keep helix crisp laterally)
Emitter Size Y (~pitch: bridges coils into a wall — THE coil-fusion fix)
Turbulence Scale (finer noise breaks the diagonal helix grain)
expressions: var angRev=22.0;var climb=2.2;var p=(time/climb)%1;var ang=time*angRev*2*Math.PI;var yB=640,yT=150;var y=yB+(yT-yB)*p;var rB=20,rT=150;var r=rB+(rT-rB)*Math.pow(p,0.75);[640+r*Math.sin(ang),y,r*Math.cos(ang)]
Emitter Position (r4: constant-climb sawtooth — no turnaround dwell => no density bulges; 48 revs/pass + box fuse => smooth funnel)
